docs.purpose: The one web FORM binding: it turns a FORM descriptor and its content file into props for the standard library (RJSF with the Mantine theme). Every converted web FORM surface renders through it; it holds no display text of its own.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing itself: the mount file passes the descriptor, the content strings and the data the page already fetched.
docs.under_126: **PROMOTED BINDING ENTRY** (P42-D9 a): a platform_shared census entry that owns the binding module, so R-13 totality holds while the converted surfaces own no component.

inputs.why: Descriptor, content and data arrive as props from the mount file.

outputs.why: A binding writes nothing; a form submit is handed back to the mount file.

state.why: No store: the library component holds its own local UI state.

staleness.why: It renders what it is given.

session.why: Its only consumers today are /admin/** pages; each consumer declares its own guard.

rls_class.why: media_assets is Class B by Spec 114 §2's definitional rule and carries the ONE ruled admin-read pattern (Wave 1 decision batch item 1): RLS on, one media_assets_select_admin policy (profiles.is_admin), no write policy; the routes read and write through the owner connection, so the policy is defence in depth.
evidence: docs/specs/00-architecture/114_rls_policy_catalog.md §2 dated note 2026-11-09 — the one ruled admin-read pattern (media_assets, offers, advertisers)

checks.why: The module is listed in bindings.json modules and owned by this entry (FE-31 C-3); a module nobody owns is a hand-built component.

errors.why: Errors belong to the consuming surface; the binding throws on a missing content key or an unknown widget so a gap is loud.

offers.why: It manages the image files a SLOT or the report renders; it renders no sponsored placement itself.
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §6.5 dated note 2026-11-09 — the surface-media bucket, admin scope, signed URLs

metering.why: An operator act, not a metered product action; the admin preview ledger is deferred (Spec 114 §6 dated note 2026-11-09).
evidence: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §6.5 dated note 2026-11-09 — the surface-media bucket, admin scope, signed URLs
